verdict.rationale: Xero publishes an official MCP server (xero-mcp-server) documented on Xero's developer site and GitHub, providing standardized MCP-protocol access to contacts, chart of accounts, invoices, etc., and is bundled with an AI Toolkit including OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain examples. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server's reliability or breadth beyond first-party docs.
